newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures ease on Japanese holiday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures ease on Japanese holiday.

text.p: Rubber futures were untraded today but were indicated at softer levels with most traders sidelined on lack of fresh factors and in line with a holiday in Japan, brokers said on Monday.
"The market was quiet and featureless today on a lack of fresh incentives. A shortage of players due to market holidays in Tokyo and Kobe also limited activity," a local broker said.

"The market was dead today. There was no news and with the closure of the Japanese markets nobody wanted to open or hold new positions. But we might see some activity tomorrow when the Japanese markets reopen," another broker said.
At 0945 GMT, December RSS3 was indicated at 126.00 U.S. cents a kg compared with last Friday's settlement of 126.50 cents.
December RSS1 was indicated at 180.00 Singapore cents (US$1.28) a kg against 181.00 cents.
December TSR20 was indicated at 174.75 Singapore cents (US$1.24) a kg from 176.25 cents.
